full_judgment: Mr. Abdul Hamid Chowdhury. learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the impugned judgment of the High Court Division is not a proper judgment of reversal in as much as the learned Judge erred in reversing the concluded finding of facts by the lower appellate court and did not consider the materials on record and discuss the evidence of P.Ws. and D. Ws. Mr. Chowdhury next submits that the lower appellate court dismissed the suit holding that Amalnama Ext. 2 and dakhila Ext. 1(C) have not been legally proved by proper evidence and the same were created for the purpose of the suit and those are not genuine documents and that Hridoy Nath's alleged settlement from the landlord has not foundation. But the learned Judge of the High Court Division erred in reversing the judgment of the lower appellate court without taking into consideration the plaintiffs document in the light of the evidence on record.
